messages.author: e063c2b8771183d2
messages.subject: Encounter rates
parts:
Dear list,

I have a doubt regarding encounter rate estimates that I need some light. I
am assessing effects of hunting on some species in two very similar areas.
I have a small number of observations for some species so I estimated
encounter rates with distance, but the output shows the group encounter
rate. How should I proceed to estimate encounter rate of individuals, is it
just a multiplication by mean cluster size (and how about CI)?

Is there any chance to get a log file with estimates per survey to be used
to compare means between sites? (like a t-test)

Thanks in advance,

Leonardo F.

messages.author: 5140016d70f6ba82
messages.subject: Re: Encounter rates
parts:
You can get the equivalent of what you want (scaled by 2w) if you
specify a uniform key with no adjustments. That will analyse the data
as a strip transect and the individual density estimates are simply the
encounter rates divided by 2w. Not sure why you are doing what you are
doing though.

--jeff
